Maya (CSM): Heads-up — LanternCorp renewal ~7w. Usage cratered ~60% last 30d, embeddings + rerank. AE heard they kicked off a 2-week NebulaAI POC. Need fast triage.
Jordan (AM): Any known trigger? billing, infra, security hold?
Maya (CSM): They ran a SAML/SSO migration on 2024-11-10 and paused nightly batch scoring. No billing incidents. Several power users marked inactive.
Devon (Solutions Eng): Checked logs for their prod key: surge of 429s + auth failures after SSO cutover. Snippet: ```AUTH ERROR: invalid_assertion for user=lantern-admin at 2024-11-10T23:02Z```
Luca (AE): If it's auth-related, they might test Nebula in parallel. Can we offer an unblock (short Dedicated window) while they finish migration?
Ana (RevOps): We can greenlight a 10-day dedicated trial but need engineering mitigations first and clear success metrics.
Maya (CSM): Proposed quick plan: 1) short-term account override to re-enable legacy token fallback for 48h, 2) enable prefix KV for rerank routes, 3) 30m sync with Lantern infra + procurement.
Devon (Solutions Eng): I can push an override: ```account_override: lanterncorp {auth_fallback: legacy_token, kv_cache: prefix_on, debug: true}``` Low risk. Will run smoke: 200 embeds and check tail latency < 450ms.
Jordan (AM): I'll pull seat activity + top-10 route heatmap and share by EOD. Want to see if inactivity matches SSO timeline.
Luca (AE): I'll draft a procurement note: trial terms + comparison vs Nebula (latency, tokens, model parity). Include a 1-page exec summary.
OpsBot: Reminder: LanternCorp renewal meeting on 2025-01-15 requires exec confirmation.
Maya (CSM): Agenda for revive call: 1) what changed (Lantern infra) 2) mitigation demo 3) trial offer & timelines 4) measures for renewal. If no reply in 72h escalate to exec outreach.
Devon (Solutions Eng): Override staged to prod in 20m. Smoke run will be posted. Validation curl: ```curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer lantern-prod' https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/embed -d '{"input":"hello"}'```
Jordan (AM): Export uploaded: https://redwood.example.com/internal/exports/lantern_heatmap_1830000001.csv (internal). Seat churn + inactive list included.
Maya (CSM): Thanks. Action items recap: Jordan - export (EOD). Devon - override + smoke (24h). Luca - procurement note + exec slide (48h). Maya - send invite + run playbook step. If we don't get engagement within 72h, escalate to Ana for executive outreach.
Luca (AE): Got it. I'll include a short clause: proof-of-concept parity check (1k prompts) to win back trust.
Maya (CSM): Great — ping me when smoke is green and I'll lock the invite.
Ana (RevOps): If Lantern declines the trial, prep a one-touch retention offer (rev credit + dedicated window) and I will approve the escalation.
Maya (CSM): Noted. Playbook ref: https://redwood.example.com/playbooks/renewal-rescue (internal). Reconvene after smoke test. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
